page_title: MAL 3-0 RAY | Mallorca v Rayo Vallecano 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+4' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Jan Virgili (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
87' 4:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
85' The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
84' Rayo Vallecano hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
81' Martin Demichelis prepares a substitution. Pablo Maffeo is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
81' Martin Demichelis has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) replacing Manu Morlanes.
81' Randy Nteka goes off the pitch and Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
80' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
80' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to David Lopez (Mallorca).
78' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Alvaro Garcia.
76' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

76' The game is pretty dull as Rayo Vallecano are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
72' Martin Demichelis decides to make a substitution. Samu Costa will be replaced by Marash Kumbulla (Mallorca).
72' A substitution has been made. Pablo Torre goes off and Takuma Asano (Mallorca) comes on.
70' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Leo Roman has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
70' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
68' The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Ilias Akhomach.
65' 3 - 0 Goal! The ball from the resulting free kick arrives at the feet of Jan Virgili (Mallorca) inside the box, and he fires a lovely shot into the right side of the goal.
65' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.

64' Close! Johan Mojica (Mallorca) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
62' Problems for Martin Demichelis as Zito Luvumbo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jan Virgili (Mallorca) replaces him.
61' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

59' What an opportunity! Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
58' Fouls committed – 9:9.
56' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post.
56' Mallorca will take a corner kick.
53' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Leo Roman, who smothers the ball.
49' Mallorca hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
46' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Oscar Valentin.
46' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nobel Mendy.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+3' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Leo Roman to dive and make a save.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) but poses no threat.
44' Rayo Vallecano are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
43' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
43' Great teamplay by Mallorca as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

40' 2 - 0 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) meets a perfect cross from Zito Luvumbo deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a strike into the middle of the goal. The score is 2:0.

39' Samu Costa (Mallorca) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
36' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.
34' Rayo Vallecano are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

31' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
29' Nice passing game by Rayo Vallecano. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
26' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
24' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Dani Cardenas to dive and make a save.
23' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
22' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
19' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
18' Flag goes up against Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
15' Neat passing move from Mallorca in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
10' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
9' Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
6' Mallorca get a corner.
5' Mallorca hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
4' Mallorca earn a corner.
4' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

3' Rayo Vallecano players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
2' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
